chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 125: Speed vs. Numbers – Ji Ning vs. Immortal Xu Li
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's incredible speed forces Immortal Xu Li to abandon brute force tactics. The Wanxiang Adept counters with a devastating seventy-two flying sword formation, turning the battle into a war of attrition.
og_title: Speed Meets Its Match in a Wall of Swords!
og_description: Ji Ning’s Windwing Evasion is unmatched, but Immortal Xu Li reveals a classic counter: overwhelming numbers. Can one sword formation break another?
twitter_title: The ‘Net’ vs. The ‘Arrow’ — Xianxia Tactics at their finest!
twitter_description: Ji Ning dodges everything until his enemy summons seventy-two swords. The real fight begins now!
